modelDetailBlock.title: Model Detail
modelDetailBlock.description: A model detail page with product-owned API-key handoff, code examples, benchmark data, and endpoint information.
modelDetailBlock.dataBoundaryBody: The block never receives or renders an existing API key. The product layer owns the key-management route through onRequestApiKey.
modelDetailBlock.mockBehaviorBody: The documentation preview only confirms a requested handoff; it never creates or displays a key.
modelDetailBlock.responsiveBody: At xl the Read me and benchmark content stays left while the 407px Quickstart rail is right. Below xl the quickstart content is presented first; code and benchmark tables scroll only within their own regions.
